summary: Design and validate the first additional Dutch risk source
description: Select tellows as the first Netherlands licensed-risk candidate, record a machine-valid acquisition contract from current primary-source evidence, define the minimum privacy-safe field and semantic boundary, and prove the source remains inert until written rights, privacy, takedown, provenance, credentials, and contract gates pass.
acceptance: A machine-valid acquisition contract selects tellows for NL using current primary-source evidence and explicitly records why Hiya is not the first fit.
The contract admits only bounded aggregate risk fields and forbids names, comments, location, lookup demand, raw inventories, positive safety claims, and copied production payloads.

The source remains disabled and makes zero runtime requests until an executed agreement explicitly covers extraction, caching, derived labels, public display, territory, attribution, correction, deletion, audit, termination, and credentials.
Source-specific schema tests, existing source-registry and ingestion tests, architecture conformance, and make check pass.
